Today's quiz reviews for Tuesday's midterm. It covers Topics 1 to 8, with most of it on Topics 6 to 8: sampling distributions, hypothesis tests, the t-test and confidence intervals. Bring a calculator, your notes and your questions.

We go over each answer as we go, and then there's time for your questions before the midterm. The quiz is worth 10 points, and being there earns the lab's 3 points (see the [syllabus](/syllabus.qmd#quizzes)).
